data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 claims the sustained flags 'arise not from the critics' stances' but from an artifact-selection function that 'biases the sample toward confirmations,' yet it offers no falsificationist commitment or evidence linking the observed flags to that mechanism. Because the critic's own stances under §11.3 are a direct, sufficient source of sustained flags, attributing the outcome solely to the harness's selection function is unsupported and ignores a required cause of the adjudication result.
